subject: Class and category of data items and literals
notes: Rule: '1) An elementary data item described as national by its PICTURE character-string.' (cite.py OK). PictureAnalyzer assigns PicCategory.National (no EditMask) to a PIC N string; PictureCategoryDriftTests pins the category against §13.18.40.4 GR9. Probe p2.cob: MOVE FUNCTION NATIONAL-OF("ab") TO a PIC N(2) item, BYTE-LENGTH = 4 (2 bytes per national char under D-N1).
